# Moroccanzest

> Moroccanzest is an artisan marketplace curated by founder Safaa, offering authentic handcrafted Moroccan products including jewelry, home decor, traditional cookware, and beauty products sourced directly from Morocco.

Founded by Safaa, a native Moroccan designer, Moroccanzest specializes in premium, handcrafted items including Berber jewelry, tagine pots, hammam beauty products, and home décor. The site also offers guided tours of Marrakech and the Merzouga desert region, combining e-commerce with experiential travel offerings.

## Shop by Product Category

- [Shop](https://moroccanzest.com/shop): Main shop catalog featuring Moroccan handicrafts, jewelry, home decor, and artisanal goods
- [Berber Jewelry](https://moroccanzest.com/product-category/berber-jewelry): Handcrafted Berber jewelry collection featuring necklaces, gemstones, and vintage silver
- [Moroccan Hammam Products](https://moroccanzest.com/product-category/moroccan-hammam): Premium Moroccan hammam beauty products including argan oil, black soap, and kessa gloves
- [Tagine Pots](https://moroccanzest.com/product-category/tagine-pot): Moroccan tagine pots and traditional cookware handcrafted from Morocco
- [Moroccan Tea Sets](https://moroccanzest.com/product-category/moroccan-tea-set): Handmade Moroccan tea sets with engraved teapots and traditional accessories
- [Moroccan Poufs & Ottomans](https://moroccanzest.com/product-category/moroccan-poufs-ottomans): Handmade Moroccan leather poufs and bohemian ottomans for home decor

## Travel & Experiences

- [Marrakech Tours](https://moroccanzest.com/product-category/marrakech-tours): Guided Marrakech and desert tours including day trips and Ourika Valley experiences
